data.text: I commit to catch 15 tons today and donate the $15,000 proceeds to the clinic. I’ll also catch no more than six tons next month. My family taught me that looking after this lake means looking after the village’s future, too. Let’s pool the donations and get a receipt confirming the clinic receives all $60,000 today. Luke, will you also commit to no more than six tons next month so all five of us are bound by the recovery plan?
